[d7] Al Jazeera reported that "Jorge Martin has been crowned the 2024 MotoGP world champion after finishing third in the season-ending Solidarity Grand Prix" in Barcelona on November 17, 2024. [d9] Eurosport confirmed that "Jorge Martin is the new MotoGP world champion following the final race of the season in Barcelona," noting he is the first independent (satellite) rider world champion in the recent MotoGP era. [d5] and [d8] also corroborate that Martin clinched his maiden MotoGP title with Pramac Racing. Some older sources such as [d3], [d6], and [d10] identify Francesco Bagnaia as the MotoGP World Champion, but these refer to the 2022 season and are superseded by the 2024 result.
